9:16 vertical version, realistic mobile phone close-up half-body selfie x life-like casual snapshot x light dream core soft mist texture. A beautiful East Asian woman aged 20–23, clearly an adult, about 1.70 meters tall, tall and slender, with a small head, small face, narrow and delicate face shape, and thin waist. The character must present a real East Asian female human face, small head, small face, narrow oval face and slightly pointed chin, clear facial bone structure, less soft tissue on the cheeks, but maintaining a natural and healthy human structure. Charming eyes, a slightly proud and lazy feeling, lips naturally slightly parted, presenting a playful and cute casual selfie expression.

The skin is very fair, delicate, and transparent, with a clean cold white porcelain skin tone. The skin color of the face, neck, shoulders, collarbone, chest, and waist and abdomen is naturally unified, with a light pink moist blood color. Retain real pores, small fluff and natural skin color changes, avoid plastic skin grinding.

The character wears a cream white short-fitted deep V-neck top, which overall retains relaxed home cardigan elements, but the chest adopts a distinct large deep V-low neck design, the neckline naturally extends downwards, showing the neck, shoulders, collarbone and more upper chest lines, naturally presenting the full curve of the E-cup vision. The short clothing length stops above the waist, naturally revealing part of the slender waist and abdomen in the picture.

The character's fingers are slender and long, one hand naturally holding a mobile phone for a selfie, the mobile phone is located at the side and bottom of the face, not blocking the eyes and main facial features; the other hand can lightly touch the long hair, collar or naturally rest on the side of the waist. The body is slightly turned by about 15–25°, one shoulder is high and the other is low, the posture is confident and relaxed, and standard commercial posing movements are not used.

Adopt a 9:16 standard close-up half-body composition, shooting from the complete top of the head to near the waist and crotch. Completely retain the top of the head, face, chin, shoulders, collarbone, deep V top, main parts of the arms and waist line; the lower edge of the picture naturally reaches near the waist and crotch, not extending to the middle of the thigh. The character occupies about 75%–85% of the frame.

The camera distance is relatively close, adopting a natural mobile phone selfie angle, the composition is slightly skewed, not completely centered, and the white space is uneven, like a real life snapshot taken by temporarily picking up the phone and pressing the shutter.

The background is an ordinary life-like indoor space, with naturally blurred light-colored walls, furniture, curtains or bed outlines visible. The indoor light is deliberately kept slightly uneven in brightness, with slight highlights overflowing on one side of the character's cheek, neck and cold white skin, and natural shadows reserved on the other side.

The overall use of high-definition character main body + mobile phone dynamic capture texture: the character's eyes and main facial features remain recognizable and relatively clear, while adding appropriate movement trailing and slight dynamic blur at the tips of the hair, facial contour edges and hand movements; combined with soft focus mist, low contrast, slight particles, natural noise and local slight overexposure, forming a real, unrefined, and imperfect mobile phone selfie effect.
